aboutDescription:
Luxe Events Co. was built for clients who want an impeccable, stress-free event experience. From intimate gatherings to large-scale brand activations, our team handles every detail with meticulous precision.

Whether you need comprehensive wedding planning or a seamless corporate gala — we deliver experiences that leave a lasting impression.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book your services?
faqs.a: For large events like weddings or corporate galas, we recommend booking 9-12 months in advance. For smaller events, 3-6 months is usually sufficient, though we can sometimes accommodate tighter timelines.

faqs.q: What is your minimum budget requirement?
faqs.a: Because we focus on full-service, premium experiences, our minimum event budget starts at $15,000. Please contact us for a customized quote based on your specific needs.
While we specialize in full-service planning and design, we do offer month-of/day-of coordination packages depending on availability.
